name: Gaza
overview: Gaza, also known as Azzah, is a significant city in biblical history, marking the southern border of the Canaanites and a key Philistine stronghold (Genesis 10:19; Joshua 13:3). It was inhabited by formidable peoples such as the Avim and Anakim, who were gradually displaced by Israelite conquest, though some Anakim remained in Gaza during Joshua's time (Deuteronomy 2:23; Joshua 11:22). The city appears prominently in Israel's military campaigns, with Joshua defeating enemies as far as Gaza (Joshua 10:41), underscoring God's faithfulness to His people amidst their struggles (Deuteronomy 31:6).
